scenes.name: Acoustic Prelude & 2 AM Whispers
scenes.subtitle: Dim lamp casting warm amber shadows • Two cups resting on the wooden desk

scenes.name: Aadhi Si Raat & Tera Asar
scenes.subtitle: Sitting in the quiet hours past 2 AM • Only your presence fills the room

lines.text: Aadhi si raat hai, khamosh yeh shehar hai,
Tu saamne hai baithi, bas tera hi asar hai.
Nazrein chura ke tu jo halke se hasi hai,
Seene mein mere ik ajeeb si khalish hai.

scenes.name: Yeh Kaisa Khumaar Hai
scenes.subtitle: Shedding every defense • What kind of sweet intoxication is this?

lines.text: Yeh kaisa khumaar hai, kaisa yeh suroor hai,
Paas hoke bhi tu kyun lagti thodi door hai?
Tu hans ke bahaana koi bana degi kya?
Main sach bol doon agar, toh muskura degi kya?
Jo lafz dabe hain kabse seene mein mere,
Unhein aaj tu sun kar, gale se laga degi kya?

scenes.name: Acoustic Solo & Amber Shadows
scenes.subtitle: Fingerstyle strings vibrating in the quiet room • Melting ice in the glass

scenes.name: Melting Ice & Stolen Glances
scenes.subtitle: Watching you tuck your hair behind your ear • Asking for a gentle truth or sweet lie

lines.text: Kanch ke gilaas mein baraf pighalti hai,
Tujhse nazar milti hai, saans sambhalti hai.
Duniya ki baaton ka ab darr nahi koi,
Tere siwa dil ka ab ghar nahi koi.
Zulfon ko kaan ke peeche jo tu karti hai,
Sach kehna, tu bhi kya mujhpe hi marti hai?

scenes.name: Guitar Solo & Heartbeat
scenes.subtitle: Strings drifting through the 3 AM stillness • Unspoken feelings lingering in the air

scenes.name: 2 AM Chai & The Wanderer's Confession
scenes.subtitle: 2 AM tea and endless thoughts • A lost wanderer in your city asking to stay

lines.text: Do baje ki chai ho ya chaar baje ki baat,
Kash koi thehra de yeh haseen raat.
Log kehte hain ke main thoda sa deewaana hoon,
Tere shehar mein bhatka ek be-ghar puraana hoon.
Agar haath badha ke main rokk loon tujhe,
Bata na, yeh dil be-qasoor hai na?

scenes.name: Will You Forget by Morning?
scenes.subtitle: Looking into your eyes for a single heartbeat • What happens when daylight comes?

lines.text: Aankhon mein dekha hai maine ek pal ke liye,
Tu bhi toh ruki hai bas ek hal ke liye.
Kal subah jab roshni khidki se aayegi,
Tu kya yeh saari baatein bhool jaayegi?
Bol na... kya sach mein bhool jaayegi?

scenes.name: Gale Se Laga Degi Kya (The Climax)
scenes.subtitle: All feelings laid bare • Will you pull me close tonight?

lines.text: Yeh kaisa khumaar hai, kaisa yeh suroor hai!
Paas hoke bhi tu kyun lagti thodi door hai!
Tu hans ke bahaana koi bana degi kya?
Main sach bol doon agar, toh muskura degi kya?
Jo lafz dabe hain kabse seene mein mere,
Unhein aaj tu sun kar, gale se laga degi kya?

scenes.name: Aur Tera Khumaar Hai
scenes.subtitle: Acoustic strings dissolving into the dawn • Only your memory remains

lines.text: Haan gale se laga degi kya...
Yeh kaisa khumaar hai...
Bas tu hi tu hai...
Aur tera khumaar hai...
